ResearchProjectDef.label: Melee dodge chance repeatable tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine the training and instincts of every colonist so they dodge melee attacks more reliably.\n\nThis technology can be researched without limit: each completion counts as one layer, layers are kept forever, and the research cost rises with each layer.
